description: Page navigation for a paged collection — a row of square page cells with prev/next chevrons, or a compact "Page X of Y" readout. Truncated ranges collapse behind an ellipsis that opens a menu of the hidden pages.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name for the navigation landmark. **Give each Pagination on a
page a distinct one** — two identically named landmarks are
indistinguishable in a landmark list.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Control size; `data-density` scales each size further.

contractProps.name: variant
contractProps.description: Numbered page cells, or a compact `Page X of Y` readout for narrow containers.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Renders the child element instead of a native `<button>`, merging all
props — aria-*, data-*, event handlers, ref — onto it via
{@link Slot }. `type` is not forwarded in this mode; the child owns its
own type semantics. See the `asChild` example on {@link Button }.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content. Under `asChild`, becomes the single child element `Slot` merges props onto.

props.name: isActive
props.description:
Marks this cell as the current page: renders `primary` rather than
`secondary`, and sets `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Forwarded to the underlying `HTMLButtonElement`, or — under
`asChild` — merged onto the rendered child via {@link Slot }.

props.name: type
props.description:
The button's native `type` attribute, restricted to the three valid
values. Defaults to `"button"` (not the DOM's own default of
`"submit"`), so a `Button` placed inside a `<form>` never triggers an
accidental submit unless set explicitly.
